annotations.title: Find the keyword gap with competitors

description: The content gap between a site and 1 to 5 competitor sites (paid plans: Starter 10 runs a month, Pro 40, Agency 150): the Google keywords each competitor ranks for in the top 20 and the site does not, clustered by the competitor page that ranks. Keeps commercial and transactional keywords with low keyword difficulty, ranks the clusters by the competitors' traffic value and returns the pages to build, each with its primary keyword, keywords, search volume, average KD, traffic value and the competitor page to beat. Also returns comparison or alternatives page ideas for keywords that name a competitor, and the gap by competitor. Use it for 'what pages should I build', 'content gap' or 'keywords my competitors rank for'. Data: DataForSEO Labs, US Google by default. The same request within 7 days answers from the saved run and does not count.

intents.description: Search intents to keep. Default commercial and transactional.

max_kd.description: Highest keyword difficulty to keep. Default 20.

name: keyword_gap
